title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 sharp physical cubes, all prior accepted A13 reductions remain binding at T4. R-089 proves global progressive terminal covariance compression, the Hilbert martingale terminal ledger, the general-progressive pure-control quartic bridge, and the exact complete-cross-shell Cartan Fourier trace. R-090 proves b=grad c and compresses that trace to one conservative coefficient. A fixed active-shell/current-root first-chaos witness falsifies only the global unprojected cutoff-uniform Sobolev relaxation R-089 (3.12) for every s>0; the witness is root-diagonal and removed by the relative FAR projector, so projected CFAR remains viable and open. R-090 corrects the R-089 rational branch attribution: its two conditional variances are 2.525135276160981 and 0.2911250947727931, not one. The complete local scalar raw rational endpoint has expectation -(35840/13689)c1 e phi(1)<0. R-063 lower chaoses reconstruct the literal Wick product and may not be appended to it again; R-079 gives the canonical nonduplicating temporal decomposition. The sufficient frontier is projected Cartan H_C, complete signed rational/linear NEAR H_N, then progressive complete-packet assembly H_A inside full OVERLAP. REG, controlled-shell one-use in that assembly, Nelson, an interacting measure, and Sector A remain open.

R-090's conservative trace is exact. Its no-go witness uses one fixed active control shell, a separate finite-low background, Gaussian-heat injectivity, current-root first chaos with OU attenuation exp(-t), and an A1 real-antipodal positive-density shell subset. It falsifies the global unprojected R-089 (3.12) relaxation only; projected CFAR remains open. The rational endpoint sign is local scalar evidence, not a torus/A1 control counterexample. R-063 forests reconstruct a literal Wick product once, while R-079 decomposes the heat-transported endpoint temporally. These results do not prove projected Cartan H_C, complete signed NEAR H_N, progressive assembly H_A, REG, uniform OVERLAP, Nelson, cutoff or floor removal, or any measure theorem.
falsifier: A failure of any prior accepted A13 package assertion remains a falsifier for that package. R-090 is additionally falsified by failure of b=grad c, the exact i q Fourier recombination, the pinned LP 9/10 shell arithmetic, the current-root/A1 critical shell scaling or linear cutoff accumulation, removal of the selected witness by relative FAR, either conditional branch variance, the exact -(35840/13689)c1 e phi(1) raw endpoint expectation, R-063 Hermite reconstruction, R-079 polarization, an authority or source hash, the nine-page zero-form PDF contract, visual QA, any pinned assertion count, or a release assertion.
